Hi Alicia,

Thanks again for the time today — really valuable conversation. Quick recap and signal checks so we're aligned before the deep-dive: 
- Primary use case: near-real-time personalization for user feeds (low-latency, moderate throughput)
- Expected scale: ~1M monthly active users, peak ~300k req/day
- Key constraints: VPC/private networking, audit logs retention, and SOC 2 evidence

Proposed next step: 45-minute technical deep-dive with a product demo focused on latency/cost tradeoffs and deployment options. Two slots that work on our side (PT):
- Tue Feb 16 — 10:00–10:45 AM PT
- Wed Feb 17 — 2:00–2:45 PM PT

Please let me know which slot works best and who from your side will join so I can include the right engineers on our end. If neither slot works, share 2–3 windows and we’ll align.

I attached a short product overview and a draft SOW to help your procurement and technical teams prep.

Thanks,
